description:
Get or create the TEST store behind one of your live stores: same token page, a copy of its catalog at creation, and orders that are paid with iap_test_pay instead of on chain (no money, no fee). Mint its keys with iap_create_store_key on the returned store id; they start cd_iap_test_. Needs account credentials (a session or CHAINDADDY_API_KEY) with manager role on the token page. Available where test mode is on (GET /api/v2/iap/config → testMode).

Params: store_id (the live store), session_token?
Returns: {ok, store: Store} with mode 'test'
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404 (TEST_MODE_DISABLED where test mode is off)

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_open_test_store
title: Open a test store
